stories.title: YRP İstanbul Milletvekili Bekin 'istemeyerek' istifa etti: 'Bana acı verse de...'

en.title: YRP Istanbul Deputy Bekin Resigned 'Reluctantly': 'Even if it pains me...'
en.summary: A deputy from the Yeniden Refah Party resigned from his positions as Vice Chairman and board member at the request of party leader Fatih Erbakan, stating he did so reluctantly despite personal difficulty.

stories.title: CHP'de 5 belediye başkanı için ihraç kararı

en.title: CHP Decides to Expel 5 Municipal Mayors
en.summary: The CHP's disciplinary board has made an expulsion decision regarding five municipal mayors, including officials in Istanbul, Antalya and other districts.

stories.title: Fatih Erbakan istedi, Milletvekili Doğan Bekin istifa etti: AKP’ye geçeceği iddia edilmişti

en.title: Fatih Erbakan Requested, Deputy Doğan Bekin Resigned: He Was Alleged to Move to AKP
en.summary: A Yeniden Refah Party deputy who had been rumored to switch to the AKP has resigned following a request from his party's leader.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 3 şüpheli tutuklama talebiyle sevk edildi

en.title: New Development in Fund Investigation: 3 Suspects Referred with Arrest Demands
en.summary: In a fund investigation, six suspects were referred to court; three of them were sent to a judge with arrest requests while one was referred for judicial supervision.

stories.title: Bebeğini çöpe attığı iddia edilen anne için ağırlaştırılmış müebbet talebi

en.title: Aggravated life sentence demanded for mother accused of throwing baby in trash
en.summary: A prosecutor has requested an aggravated life sentence against a woman in Samsun accused of disposing of her newborn baby in the trash. The defendant denies the charges, claiming the baby was stillborn.

stories.title: TFF tarafından PFDK'ye sevk edilmişti: Ertuğrul Doğan'dan bahis soruşturması açıklaması!

en.title: Ertuğrul Doğan makes statement on betting investigation after TFF referral to PFDK
en.summary: Trabzonspor Club President Ertuğrul Doğan commented on his referral to the Professional Football Disciplinary Board regarding a betting investigation.

stories.title: Psikolog Nurselen Gülaçtı'nın öldürülmesi: Sanığa ağırlaştırılmış müebbet hapis cezası verildi

en.title: Psychologist Nurselen Gülaçtı's killing: Defendant sentenced to aggravated life imprisonment
en.summary: A defendant in Ankara received an aggravated life sentence for shooting psychologist Nurselen Gülaçtı with a handgun in her workplace, convicted of intentional premeditated murder.

stories.title: TFF'nin listesinde kulüp başkanı bulunuyor... Bahis soruşturmasında PFDK'ye sevk edilenler açıklandı!

en.title: Club president on TFF list: Those referred to PFDK in betting investigation announced
en.summary: The Turkish Football Federation disclosed names of individuals who served as administrators in Super League and First League clubs within the past five years and were identified as placing bets during their tenure.

stories.title: TFF, bahis oynadığı tespit edilen kulüp yöneticilerini açıkladı! 448 yönetici PFDK'ya sevk edildi

en.title: TFF announces club executives found to have engaged in betting! 448 executives referred to PFDK
en.summary: Turkish football authorities identified 448 club executives who engaged in betting and referred them to the disciplinary board for proceedings.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! CHP'den 5 belediye başkanına ihraç kararı

en.title: BREAKING: CHP decides to expel 5 municipal mayors
en.summary: The CHP party has decided to expel five municipal mayors including those from Sarıyer, Kadıköy, Sancaktepe, Konyaaltı, and Alanya.

stories.title: Psikolog Nurselen'i öldüren sanığa ağırlaştırılmış müebbet

en.title: Defendant who killed psychologist Nurselen receives aggravated life sentence
en.summary: Fuat Yıldırım received an aggravated life sentence for the premeditated killing of psychologist Nurselen Gülaçtı at her workplace.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | Bakan Gürlek açıkladı: Fon soruşturmasında 5. dalga operasyon! 34 şüpheli hakkında gözaltı kararı

en.title: BREAKING: Minister Gürlek announces fifth wave of operation in fund investigation! Detention orders issued for 34 suspects
en.summary: Justice Minister Akın Gürlek announced the fifth wave of operations in fund investigations conducted by Istanbul's chief prosecutor, resulting in detention orders for 34 suspects.

en.title: Stock market loses 4.5 trillion lira in one month
en.summary: Istanbul Stock Exchange experienced a 4.5 trillion lira decline in market value after Tera and Pusula portfolio funds failed to meet redemption payments. The index fell 16.65 percent in September, closing at 11,947 points.

en.title: 5 firms under fund investigation transferred to TMSF
en.summary: The banking regulator announced that management of Tera Investment Bank, Destek Investment Bank, Hedef Investment Bank, Destek Factoring, and Tera Finance Factoring has been transferred to the deposit insurance fund TMSF.

en.title: Istanbul Stock Exchange closes day with losses
en.summary: The BIST 100 index on Istanbul Stock Exchange declined 2.79 percent, ending the trading day at 11,947.18 points.

stories.title: Azerbaycan'a HÜRKUŞ-II ihracatı: 14 uçak için imzalar atıldı

en.title: Azerbaijan export of HÜRKUŞ-II aircraft: Contracts signed for 14 planes
en.summary: Turkey's Defense Industry President announced that 14 HÜRKUŞ-II aircraft will be delivered to Azerbaijan, with defense industry agreements totaling over 500 million dollars signed between the two countries.

stories.title: Hazine’nin 3 aylık borçlanma planı açıklandı: 630,7 milyar liralık iç borçlanma öngörülüyor

en.title: Treasury's 3-month borrowing plan announced: 630.7 billion lira in domestic borrowing projected
en.summary: Turkey's Treasury and Finance Ministry plans to conduct 630.7 billion lira in domestic borrowing during October-December to service 676.6 billion lira in domestic debt obligations, through 11 bond auctions and 5 direct sales.
